d:
Victor Wembanyama scored 32 points on 13-for-18 shooting with 9 rebounds and 5 blocks as the Spurs came back from 22 points down to beat the Bulls, 124-119, for their 10th straight win!
San Antonio trailed 66-44 late in the second quarter and rallied for the second-largest road comeback in franchise history in the play-by-play era, behind only a 23-point comeback at Chicago on March 17, 2021.
During the 10-game win streak, Wembanyama is averaging 32.6 points, 11.4 rebounds and 4.5 blocks per game, and the Spurs are outscoring opponents by an average of 15.0 points.
